d: Long, messy platinum white hair with jagged bangs frames a youthful face with heterochromia, featuring one vivid crimson eye and one bright lime-green eye. The slim build is dressed in a dark navy blue shirt under a glossy, oversized white streetwear jacket detailed with neon pink and yellow accents, a red-and-black circular arm patch, and a black buckled strap around the sleeve. A black cap with two pointed cat-ear protrusions is worn atop the head, adorned with various colorful stickers and pins, while a black choker with a gold star charm encircles the neck. A pink bubblegum bubble is blown from the lips.
